findings.evidence: Roadmap `NumberFieldArithmetic/Suggested.lean:1564` states `exists_unit_normalization_at_real_place` with `(B) (hB : 1 < B) (hv : v ∉ torsion K) (hvB : |Real.log (w v)| < Real.log B)`; the PR declaration at lines 64–72 instead requires `u`, `hu`, and two log-embedding norm hypotheses.
findings.fix: Prove the arbitrary-bound normalization theorem first (with rank one to turn non-torsion into nonzero value at `w`), then derive this `B = w u` specialization as a corollary if useful.
findings.issue: `exists_normalized_unit_between` unnecessarily couples normalization to a second unit `u` and log-embedding norm comparison; the normalization needed by the candidate API naturally takes arbitrary `B > 1`, `v ∉ torsion K`, and `|log (w v)| < log B`.

summary: The core normalization theorem is specialized to comparison with a chosen unit, while the roadmap’s natural reusable normalization is parameterized by an arbitrary bound.
